Container.Name: homebridge-ffmpeg-intel
Container.Overview: Homebridge (Ubuntu base) bundled with Jellyfin's hardware-accelerated FFmpeg build for Intel Quick Sync transcoding. Plugins must be configured to use the FFmpeg binary at /usr/lib/jellyfin-ffmpeg/ffmpeg (the stock /usr/bin/ffmpeg is left untouched).
Container.Description:
Homebridge with Jellyfin FFmpeg for Intel Quick Sync hardware transcoding.
After install, point any Homebridge plugin that calls FFmpeg (e.g. Unifi-Video) at:
/usr/lib/jellyfin-ffmpeg/ffmpeg
Verify with: docker exec homebridge-ffmpeg-intel /usr/lib/jellyfin-ffmpeg/ffmpeg -version
This image is AMD64-only by design (Intel hardware acceleration).

Config.Name: Intel GPU (DRI)
Config.Description: Intel iGPU device passthrough for Quick Sync. Required for hardware-accelerated FFmpeg.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Homebridge Config UI port. Informational only when network mode is host.

Config.Name: HOMEBRIDGE_CONFIG_UI
Config.Description: Enable the Homebridge Config UI (1 = on, 0 = off).

Config.Name: HOMEBRIDGE_CONFIG_UI_PORT
Config.Description: Port the Config UI listens on.

Config.Name: ENABLE_AVAHI
Config.Description: Enable Avahi/mDNS inside the container for HomeKit discovery.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID for file permissions (Unraid default: 99 = nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID for file permissions (Unraid default: 100 = users).
